messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — we’ll do the midnight change window for rollout v3.2.0 at 00:30 UTC. Main goals: pin model hash, start 5% shadow traffic, monitor latency & error budget. @sam can you take ops handoff?

sam: On it. I’ll be on pager. Setting up dashboards + alerts now. What are our explicit rollback criteria?

maria: Product note — abort if completion rate (streaming) drops >3% vs baseline or embeddings error rate >0.5% sustained for 2m.

alex: Add hardware signals: GPU temp spike >80C or sustained CPU load >90% -> abort. We’ll pin model to `c7d9f2` for the canary.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout v3.2.0 -> canary group at 00:30 UTC. Plan: pin -> deploy canary -> enable shadow 5% -> monitor 30m -> promote if stable.

sam: Dashboards created: /dash/rollout/v3.2.0. Alerts: p99 latency >220ms for 3m, error rate >0.5% for 2m, model-regression >1% on eval set.

alex: Ops preflight checklist:
- lock change window in calendar
- run smoke `make smoke-canary`
- run cache warm script `scripts/warm_cache.sh --targets=all`
- verify autoscaler fallback tier available
- confirm log retention for 24h

maria: Product will hit `/evals/nightly/v3.2` with canonical prompts at 00:40 and report quality delta. I’ll post quick summaries.

oncall-bot: sam is now on call for change-window (00:25-01:30 UTC).

sam: Preflight running: smoke passed locally, cache warm completed, load test against canary endpoint looks sane. Deploying in 2m.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started -> instances [i-0a1b2c3d, i-0f4e5d6c]. Shadow traffic enabled at 5%.

alex: Monitoring live — initial p95 and error rates within baseline. Watching SLO panels. If anyone types 'abort' here we trigger rollback immediately.

maria: Saw one minor rerank mismatch in evals at 00:45, low severity. Logging it but not aborting.

sam: No infra alerts. Increasing shadow -> canary traffic to 25% at 01:00 after stable 35m. Will keep running to 02:00 then consider full rollout.

alex: Perfect. Post-deploy tasks: update release notes with pinned model `c7d9f2`, note shadow strategy, and document any eval diffs. Cleanup at ~02:30 UTC. :thumbsup:

maria: I’ll post quality summary by 01:10.

sam: Acknowledge — staying on watch.

deploy-bot: Canary -> 25% traffic promoted at 01:00 UTC. No alerts triggered since rollout start.

alex: Thanks team — keeping this thread as single source for rollback decisions. If we see regression, call it now.
